title: Richard Brome Online
author: Richard Brome
institution: Royal Holloway, University of London and Digital Humanities Institute, Sheffield (general editor Richard Cave)
notes: Edition of the fifteen surviving plays of Richard Brome and The Late Lancashire Witches (with Heywood), with the original quarto or octavo text and an annotated modern-spelling text side by side, essays, a glossary, stage histories and recorded workshop performances. Published 2010 (AHRC-funded); no later update seen. Copyright is held by Royal Holloway. The counts cover the original-spelling text, not the modernised version. Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
